cc:Work.dc:title: Box - RegularStarBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Regular polygon boxes that form a star when closed
![Open box](static/samples/RegularStarBox-2.jpg)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes RegularStarBox --n 4 --radius 70 --h 60 --outside 0 --thickness 4 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes RegularStarBox --n --radius --h --outside --thickness --reference --labels
